do_not_change.summary: Keep the app-only review source limited to the controller Signal ID.
do_not_change.evidence: The strict wrapper permits only reviewSource.signalId; composition maps only that field, and schema coverage rejects runId and relationship.
do_not_change.impact: Preserves ADR-045/047's browser and MCP boundary for Run coordinates and graph relationships.
do_not_change.recommendation: Do not expose Run IDs, graph rows, relationship fields or raw evidence through the Opportunities DTO.

do_not_change.evidence: The query filters authorized project, emitted Recommendation IDs, controller relationship and null release timestamp. The live test uses withPgClient and valid project-cascade cleanup.
do_not_change.impact: Prevents foreign, suppressed and released links from granting review access.
do_not_change.recommendation: Retain this bounded lookup and do not add read-time source inference, adoption or writes.

do_not_change.summary: Keep Opportunities on the existing priority-Recommendation query-key prefix and invalidate it after investigation decisions.
do_not_change.evidence: The inbox query uses the shared project prefix; approval and review invalidate it, while approval also invalidates Work and project summary.
do_not_change.impact: Maintains membership consistency after approval, dismissal, snooze and Review now.
